title: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users with common operational roles to access Bank Transaction amounts and bank accounts of other companies by sending crafted requests that bypass proper access controls.
